title: Matthew 25:31-46
subtitle: Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe · Ez 34:11-12, 15-17; 1 Cor 15:20-26, 28; Mt 25:31-46
text: On the last Sunday of the Church year, Christ the King tells us what he will ask at the end: did we feed the hungry, clothe the naked, visit the sick and imprisoned? "Whatever you did for one of the least brothers of mine, you did for me." Serve one of the least today.
imageAlt: Gold-ground icon of Christ enthroned in an orange robe, blessing with his right hand and holding an open book, surrounded by red seraphim and angels on an ornate carved throne
